paragraphs: A Mercedes-Benz OM656 engine rebuild starts from £3,600, regardless of which of the six models it's fitted to — the price tier is set by the engine, not the badge on the boot. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available.
Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.

cards.title: Rebuilding Your
cards.body: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We rebuild the engine your Mercedes already has instead — strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component with updated OEM parts. You get a near-new engine with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, without the compatibility risk of an unknown used unit. This is the option most OM656 owners choose.

cards.title: Replacement
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we also offer full engine replacement and fitting — sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: Used
cards.body: In some cases, a matched low-mileage used engine is the right call — particularly if you need your car back on the road quickly and your existing engine's damage is extensive. We can source and fit these too, though most owners who ask about used engines end up choosing a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risk a used unit carries.

options.body: "Reconditioned" is the term many owners search for when they mean the same thing as a rebuild — a full strip-down, inspection, and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.
"Refurbished" often describes the same process from a different angle — restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild covers this.

Some owners specifically search for a "remanufactured" engine, expecting a unit rebuilt to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers, regardless of which of the six OM656-equipped models you drive.

faqLeft.q: What is the Mercedes-Benz OM656 engine?
faqLeft.a: The OM656 is Mercedes-Benz's turbocharged 2.9-litre inline-six diesel engine, in production since 2017. It's fitted across four Mercedes-Benz SUV models — G-Class, GLC, GLE and GLS.

faqLeft.q: Which Mercedes-Benz models use the OM656?
faqLeft.a: G-Class (G 350 d, G 400 d), GLC-Class (GLC 300 d), GLE-Class (GLE 350 d, GLE 400 d), and GLS (GLS 350 d, GLS 400 d) — see the full applications table above for exact details.

faqLeft.q: Does the OM656 differ between Mercedes-Benz models?
faqLeft.a: The base engine code is the same, but specific ancillary fitment and 48V mild-hybrid integration vary by application. We match by registration/VIN before confirming any rebuild or replacement.

faqLeft.q: Is an OM656 from one Mercedes-Benz model compatible with another?
faqLeft.a: Not automatically — even though it's the same base engine, ancillaries and hybrid-system integration differ between models like the G-Class and GLE. We always confirm compatibility by registration/VIN.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes-Benz OM656 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,800, regardless of which model it's fitted to. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.
Yes. We work on OM656 rebuilds across every model it's fitted to, replacing worn components as standard.

faqLeft.q: Do you work on OM656 mild-hybrid applications?
faqLeft.a: Yes. OM656 48V MHEV applications are within our workshop capability, with the relevant hybrid-system ancillaries accounted for once your exact model is confirmed.

faqRight.q: Can you rebuild an OM656 from a G-Class?
faqRight.a: Yes. The OM656 in the G-Class is one of the applications we work on regularly, across both the G 350 d and G 400 d.

faqRight.q: Can you rebuild an OM656 from a GLE 400 d?
faqRight.a: Yes. The OM656 in the GLE is one of the applications we work on regularly, across both the GLE 350 d and GLE 400 d.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Mercedes-Benz OM656 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Mercedes-Benz if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an OM656 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most OM656 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history — a particular concern given how many different OM656 applications exist across the Mercedes-Benz SUV range — and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
